messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to lisinopril: severe stomach pain, hives, difficult breathing, swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Lisinopril may cause serious side effects. Call your doctor at once if you have:
- a light-headed feeling, like you might pass out;
- high blood potassium - nausea, weakness, tingly feeling, chest pain, irregular heartbeats, loss of movement;
- low white blood cell counts - fever, mouth sores, skin sores, sore throat, cough;
- kidney problems - swelling, urinating less, feeling tired or short of breath; or
- liver problems - loss of appetite, stomach pain (upper right side), tiredness, itching, dark urine, clay-colored stools, jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes).
Common lisinopril side effects may include:
- headache, dizziness;
- low blood pressure, cough; or
- chest pain.
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur. Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects. You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["Lisinopril", "has serious side effect symptom", "clay-colored stools"]

The relation 'has serious side effect symptom' in the triplet is defined as 'An occurrence of the serious side effect caused by the subject drug may include the symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
E. 'has overdose risk': An overdose of the subject drug may result in the serious or life-threatening consequence specified by the object entity.
